freshness_boundary.permitted_claim: external real-system BAM feasibility, falsification and target-identifiability bridge only

source.archive_name: Penobscot River Restoration Project Ecological Monitoring Data

focal_taxon.selection_basis: predeclared diadromous restoration target; retrospective bridge acknowledges published aggregate alosine response is already known

biotic_proxy_taxon.role: predeclared resident predatory/community-state proxy; both B orientations retained and no causal interaction sign is assumed

A.variable_selection_rule: after schema-only gate, use every numeric reach-level physical/water-quality field that can be linked to fish reaches without using focal fish values; exclude identifiers, timestamps, file provenance and fish-response fields
A.world_rule: derive nested multivariate support envelopes at fixed 50, 75 and 90 percent central-distance cutoffs plus unrestricted A; exact distance/standardization rule must be committed before fish-response rows are parsed

B.proxy: Micropterus dolomieu abundance or presence at the same reach/time, using pre-restoration years only for baseline state
B.world_rule: retain unrestricted B plus both low-proxy-permissive and high-proxy-permissive orientations at frozen q33 and q67 cutoffs
B.claim_boundary: B is a finite biotic-state proxy, not proof of competition or facilitation

M.network: river reach connectivity constrained by named dam/passability state
worlds: Great Works + Veazie removed + Howland bypassed

evidence_and_time_contract.world_survival: a declared world survives when every calibration focal-positive reach is in A intersect B intersect M under the relevant intervention state
evidence_and_time_contract.heldout_use: post-restoration positives may only contract/falsify the calibration-surviving world set after parser and world roster are frozen

primary: survivor-fiber contraction from pre-restoration calibration to immediate-post positives
additional contraction from immediate-post to extended-post positives
count of worlds falsified by each new positive reach
target_identifiability: whether calibration survivors unanimously permit focal access to each post-restoration reach
whether any unanimous no-access certificate is falsified by a later focal-positive observation
not_primary: reproducing published ordination or abundance trends

gates: Gate0: archive directory architecture only; no data-file download
Gate1: README/report metadata and database schema/table names only; no fish observation rows
Gate2: freeze reach registry linkage, A variables, M graph construction and B parser before focal rows
Gate3: open 2010-2012 calibration rows and contract worlds
hard_stops: do not change pre/immediate/extended time periods
do not choose B orientation from published or observed association sign
do not tune M from focal recolonization speed
do not select A variables using focal response
do not discard reaches that falsify worlds
do not call this analysis fresh or independent confirmatory evidence
do not use published aggregate fish-response direction as an endpoint
success_definition: success means the real Penobscot archive can instantiate response-independent finite A/B/M worlds and later positive observations can audit/falsify them under the frozen protocol; favorable biological direction is not required
